notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.2 : Fancy Update (Part 3)
notes.notes:
(September 15th 2025)



I've heard you loud and clear. Everybody wants a better world map. The world is too blocky! I get it.



This will be the last "Fancy Update". The next update is the big one. Don't expect it for a couple of months but I will make sure the wait is worth it. But that's next update. Here is what I've been working on these past 2 months (Other than playing silksong).

The focus of this update was to make skills look and feel more unique from one another by adding sounds and animations. I also reworked breeding to be less of a chore.


CHANGES
Tulpa : Added 8 new evolutions. (Every tulpa evolves now).

Tulpa : Most tulpas learn new and improved skills. (Cubble no longer learns a skill that regenerate mana, but no skill that uses mana)

Tulpa : Bunibble's new evolution comes in 3 unique forms. (The forms are purely aesthetic)

Tulpa : Bunibble was changed to come in 3 colors by default.

Tulpa : Some descriptions in the bestiary were improved.

Battle : Skills now have different sound effects and a few animations. (punching, throwing, dancing, etc.)

Battle : Status effects now have unique visual effects and sounds.

Battle : Added the status effects "snare" and "shackle" which prevent the target from moving.

Battle : Added the status effect "Elemental shield" which will add temporary health of a certain element, regardless of the tulpa's actual element.

Battle : Slightly decreased stutter during battle.

Battle : Added a summon/retrieve animation that also plays when you set your follower.

Battle : Added the "wake up" and "element chart" buttons from battle to the formation screen. (You can now give up before the battle even starts)

Battle : A tulpa's tooltip will now appear when you summon. (So you don't accidentally summon a tulpa with 1 HP)

Breeding : Eggs are now items and will hatch based on time, not battles fought.

Breeding : Added an animation when eggs hatch.

UI : Added an inventory screen. (The only available items are eggs)

UI : Added a counter to keep track of elements unlocked in the element chart

UI : Added a counter to keep track of tulpas caught in the bestiary.

UI : Added the last elemental background. (Light)

Overworld : The exclamation mark above wild tulpas who spot you is made of cardboard and makes a sound.

Overworld : Tulpas in later levels will now spawn as their evolved form, making later levels more difficult.

Overworld : Wild tulpas are now guaranteed to spawn with skills that do damage and will priorities skills that don't cost mana to prevent battles where nothing happens.

Overworld : Moved the dresser to the apartment to be easier to access. (It is no longer a reward for finding keys)

Overworld : Moved the breeding CD to be easier to access.
BUG FIXES
Achievement : The achievement for hatching 100 eggs should trigger correctly now.

Achievement : Changed the achievement for "having a powerlevel of over 9000" to the trainer being level 100 instead.

Lighting : Fixed a bug where the lighting would be wrongly affected by the room you are in during certain animations such as evolution.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.1.1 : Fancy Update (Quick Fix)
notes.notes:
(July 21th 2025)



There were a few bugs that snuck in the last update. This quick fix addresses all the ones that were reported.


IMPROVEMENTS
Balance : Tulpas in the reserve now get 25% of the experience even if they were not summoned.

Balance : Tulpas regenerate 2% of their max mana every turn.

Balance : Everytime you fail a catch, the catch chance increases by a small amount (Up to 33%).

UI : You can now check the tooltip of monsters in the formation screen.

World : Beds are now useable in the dream world and will simply wake you up.

World : CDs now give a popup telling you the name of the CD you just collected.

World : After some feedback, I removed the green light from the blue room (This sentence makes sense in context).
BUG FIXES
Fixed : Some skills were not checking the correct values when deciding if you could afford them. Sting in particular allowed you to kill yourself by using it.

Fixed : Tooltips in the breeding menu would show all stats as 0 if the tulpa had the passive Hivemind.

Fixed : The chef's uniform did not render and in some cases made you a floating head.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.1 : Fancy Update (Part 2)
notes.notes:
(July 16th 2025)



This update focuses on adding passives and skills to all tulpas to differentiate them more from eachothers. There are still missing features I want to add such as placing mines and walls, but this is a big step forward. To compensate for the lack of new tulpas last update, I added 6 tulpas instead of the usual 3. I hope you enjoy this new version.


ADDITIONS
Tulpa : Added 6 new evolutions.

Tulpa : Added 14 new passives.

Tulpa : Added a massive amount of new skills.

World : Added a ton of new NPCs to fight.

World : Added more objects and images to the world to make it feel less empty.

World : Added particle effects to certain zones for the atmosphere.

UI : Added 2 new elemental backgrounds.

UI : Added notifications when you unlock new clothes or new skills.

Battle : Added new status effects such as Frostbite, Mark, Snare and more.
IMPROVEMENTS
UI : Improved the evolution animation.

UI : Improved nearly every species' description.

UI : Made some tooltips more readable.

AI : Enemies will now use status effect skills and heals.

AI : Tulpas are guaranteed to spawn with at least 1 damaging skill equipped, including starters.
BALANCE CHANGES
World : Tulpas will no longer chase you once your trainer is a certain level above them.

World : Moved the breeding CD and dresser around to be less tedious to find for new players.

World : One of the secret worlds spawn lampicks instead of snoofs now.

Battle : Trainers can only put 3 tulpas on the field at the same time.

Battle : Movement and skills now uses different points that you get at the beginning of your turn allowing you to move, attack and then move again in some cases.

Battle : Using summon and retrieve no longer ends your turn (or use a skill point).

Battle : Rebalanced every tulpa's stats to be less homogenous.

Battle : Rebalanced some elements, notably Insect to be less boring and weak.
BUG FIXES
Fixed : Crash that would happen if you hovered the mouse over portraits while summoning.

Fixed : Bug where bosses would fail to spawn sometimes.

Fixed : Bug where holding the camera and entering the PC at the same time softlocked you.

Fixed : Bug where trainers would be missing when you challenge them again but not give up when you kill their last tulpa, softlocking you in battle.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.0.1 : Fancy Update
notes.notes:
(June 18th 2025)


IMPROVEMENTS
UI : The game will now ask you before opening another window.

UI : Skills now have their range in their tooltips.

UI : Added the ability to rename your character.

Evolution : The evolution animation now loads faster.

Evolution : Slightly improved the evolution animation.

Evolution : Added a skip button to the evolution animation.
BALANCE CHANGES
World : Moved around the rewards for finding the blue keys.

Element : Toxic is now neutral against Insect.

Element : Toxic is now strong against psychic.
BUG FIXES
Fixed a bug where touching enemies would fail to start a battle and you would become an immortal ghost (If this bug still happens, there is now a failsafe where using a door should fix it).

Fixed a bug where bosses would sometimes not spawn.

Fixed a bug where you would sometimes get stuck on chairs.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8 : Fancy Update
notes.notes:
(June 14th 2025)


IMPROVEMENTS
UI : Added character customization.

UI : Added a popup to see stat changes after an evolution.

UI : Re-added the feedback button that brings you to the steam forum.

UI : Added skill names to skill icons to differentiate them.

UI : Added some characters to text inputs so you can finally name your tulpa "xX_DeathAngel_Xx".

UI : Improved the look of the element chart.

Overworld : Added several trainer battles.

Overworld : Defeating trainers unlock their clothes and stuff.

Overworld : Whether or not tulpas join in against you is now based on whether they are chasing you and if you are reachable instead of being distance-based.

Overworld : You are now considered "sneaking" while not moving and on controller your detection range is based on how fast you are moving.

UX : Clicking on a monster in the formation before battles selects it.

Sound : Added an evolution jingle.

Animation : Gave everyone a cooler walk cycle.

Animation : Added scene transition animations to doors, waking up and battles.

Animation : Changed the death animation of trainers.

Animation : Added a falling-asleep/waking-up animation.

General : Changed some tulpa sizes and descriptions for consistency.

General : Improved venomiel's texture.
BALANCE CHANGES
Battle : Reduced healing in general.

Battle : Capped recoil damage to how much health the target had left.

Battle : Dodge chance is now more consistent throughout the game.

Battle : Made catching low level tulpas easier.

Battle : Made Insect-type strong against Normal-type but weak against itself.

Battle : Damage and healing are now rounded down to 1 instead of 0.

Battle : Retrieving and then re-summoning tulpas no longer remove their status effects.
BUG FIXES
Battle : Fixed a bug where starting a battle without a tulpa but later summoning it from the reserve wouldn't award it experience.

UI : Made element unlocking more reliable.

Overworld : Fixed several edge cases based around entering battle immediately after entering a door or pausing right as you get attacked.
KNOWN ISSUES
Overworld : Sometimes, switching clothes rapidly causes the wrong textures or models to load. This is purely visual and fixes itself when changing clothes again or closing and reopening the game.
